title: Son of Man
definition: Son of Man is a title Jesus used for Himself that reveals His true humanity, messianic authority, suffering, and future glory.
summary: Jesus is the Son of Man who suffered, serves, reigns, and will return in glory.
christFocus: As Son of Man, Jesus identifies with humanity, gives His life as a ransom, and receives everlasting dominion.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The title Son of Man brings together humility and glory. Jesus uses it to speak of His suffering, service, authority, and future return.

Daniel's vision shows one like a son of man receiving dominion, glory, and a kingdom. Jesus applies this title to Himself, revealing that He is the promised ruler who also suffers for His people.

As Son of Man, Jesus truly enters human life and represents His people before God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people separate Jesus' humanity from His authority. This doctrine matters because the Son of Man is both the suffering servant and the glorious King.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Follow the Son of Man in humility, service, and hope. Trust the One who came to seek and save the lost and who will return in glory.
